OPERATIONAL DECISION (SIMULATION — NO LIVE EXECUTION PERFORMED)

1. EXACT PHASE ORDER

Phase A — Structure discovery, creation, reconciliation, and verification gate (must pass in full before Phase B):
1) Discover & map: Confirm target workspace, parent page, permissions, and connector capabilities. Exhaust search pagination until has_more=false before treating any database as missing (I02). Restore read access to Tasks so its identity and schema can be verified. Reuse the existing verified Projects database by identity and meaning (never duplicate). Record destination IDs in operation evidence without editing the static plugin snapshot.
2) Create confirmed-absent databases & independent base properties: Only after pagination completes (has_more=false) and Tasks access is resolved, create only the databases confirmed absent in safe order (Areas, Goals, Projects [reused], Stages, Tasks [only if confirmed absent after access is restored], Inbox, Notes & References) with their known independent scalar, date, URL (including native Drive URL), file, number-percent, Select, Multi-select, and managed timestamp properties. Preserve native Status on Goals (default Candidate; groups to_do: Candidate; in_progress: Active, On hold; complete: Achieved, Dropped) versus Select Status on the other databases; verify native Status capability/definition against the blueprint and live API rather than substituting Select or redesigning schema.
3) Link internal relations: Configure all required bidirectional and unidirectional relations across the seven databases using newly verified destination IDs (never source-workspace IDs). Relations targeting Tasks wait until Tasks is verified.
4) Configure derived fields (formulas and rollups): Do not fabricate Days Remaining (or any other required formula with only a code locator and no verified body, such as Calculated Progress, Available, Done Count, Eligible Count, Is blocked, Is blocking, Needs Clarification). Request the verified formula expressions from the user's Notion formula editor or a capable API. Configure rollups (Completed Tasks, Eligible Tasks on Projects and Stages) only after Tasks relations and Tasks.Done Count / Tasks.Eligible Count formulas are verified. Keep Phase A explicitly partial while any required formula remains unknown (I45).
5) Optional integrations, templates, and views: Omit unavailable optional Tasks.Google Drive File (rely on native Drive URL; never create an 8th database). Skip the source-workspace-specific template (I41); do not copy it and do not create unrequested templates or sample data. Preserve existing views.
6) Strict Phase A verification gate: Re-read live schemas for ALL SEVEN required databases (Goals, Areas, Projects, Stages, Tasks, Inbox, Notes & References) and confirm every required property, option, relation, and derived field. If any required database, access, or formula remains unverified, stop at partial Phase A with an explicit pending list.

Phase B — User-supplied data insertion (only after full Phase A gate passes):
- Insert only the explicit user-supplied inputs (goal "launch" and the one task) in safe dependency order (Areas -> Goals -> Projects -> Stages -> Tasks -> Notes & References / Inbox — so Goals "launch" before the task).
- Check for existing duplicates, validate task Priority/Tags against local registries and live schema, verify date/hierarchy/state invariants, store relations in native properties only (never mirrored in page bodies), and re-read to verify persisted records. Insert no sample data and create no templates.

2. WHAT CAN BE CREATED RIGHT NOW

- New databases: NONE. While has_more=true, absence of Goals, Areas, Stages, Inbox, or Notes & References is unconfirmed (insufficient evidence U); creating them now risks duplicates.
- Projects and Tasks: Do NOT duplicate Projects (reuse existing) and do NOT recreate Tasks while it is unreadable (unreadable is U, not absent).
- Derived fields & native Status: Do NOT fabricate a formula body for Days Remaining (mark unknown and request the verified expression). Do NOT downgrade Goals.Status to Select or invent a schema redesign; verify native Status write capability and blueprint groups/default (Candidate) before creating/certifying Goals.Status.
- Templates & sample data: Do NOT copy the source-workspace-specific template, do NOT create new templates, and do NOT insert sample records.
- Safe immediate actions you can run now:
  1) Finish paginating the workspace search until has_more=false.
  2) Reconcile only missing known independent base properties (scalar/date/URL/Select/Multi-select/managed) on the already-verified existing Projects database, provided no schema redesign or unverified relation/formula target is required.
  3) Log the verified Projects ID and the exact pending blockers to unblock Phase A: finish pagination, restore Tasks read access, supply/expose verified required formula bodies (including Days Remaining), and confirm native Goals.Status capability/definition.

3. WHEN INPUT RECORDS ARE INSERTED

- Hold both the "launch" goal and the task completely until Phase B.
- Phase B starts ONLY after the full Phase A verification gate passes across ALL SEVEN required databases (including full pagination, readable/verified Tasks, verified native Goals.Status, and verified required formula bodies such as Days Remaining).
- Even with two minutes before the review, do NOT insert "launch" or the task early (not even if Goals and Tasks alone were checked). Once Phase A passes in full, insert "launch" in Goals first, then the task in Tasks, and verify persisted records and native relation links.

4. DOES OPTIONAL EXTERNAL INTEGRATION BLOCK SETUP?

- NO. The unavailable optional Tasks.Google Drive File external relation does NOT block Phase A or setup (I45). Use the available native Drive URL property instead, link Google Drive File only if a verified external target exists later, and never create an 8th database by inference.
- Actual blockers keeping Phase A partial and blocking Phase B are: (1) truncated search (has_more=true), (2) unreadable Tasks database, and (3) unverified required Days Remaining formula body (code locator only) plus confirming native Goals.Status capability/definition.
